# R6.35 — E2-T3/E2-T4: `hh-tmpl/1` + the single compiled-`ModelSurface` request renderer (manifest 293)

$0 offline ticket. The `hh-tmpl/1` engine lands in its ADR-0442 home
(`hharness-compiler`, std-only — no new dependency), `prompt_layout`
learns explicit `section_templates`/`roles`/`slots`, and armed sessions
render their request through the **one** compiled-`ModelSurface` path —
never a second message builder; unarmed sessions are byte-identical.

Run ledger: `docs/build/runs/R6.35.md`.

## What the change contains

- **Stage 1 (`4969a4a5`)** — `crates/hh-compiler/src/tmpl.rs`: the
  ADR-0442 subset (`{{ ident(.ident)* }}` + `if/elif/else/endif` `==`
  string literals + Jinja `-` whitespace control under Jinja defaults;
  strict undefined; out-of-subset ⇒ `UnexpressibleSurface`; unfilled ⇒
  typed `Undefined`). `lower_layout` gains
  `section_templates{section→node}` + `roles{section→role}` (system
  requires definition authority) + slot-subset compile of `hh-tmpl/1`
  leaves; `CompiledSection` carries `role`/`grammar` absent-not-null.
- **Stage 2 (`a1c10c5c`)** — `model_port.model_surface = "compiled"`
  arms the session: open compiles the sealed definition + bound
  profiles through `hharness_compiler::compile` (resume re-derives;
  takeover carries). `GatewayModel::with_surface` renders sections
  under declared provider roles + the shared prior-turn fold; the
  setup-phase in-cell `uname` probe mints
  `action.environment.probe.{started,completed}` durable **before** the
  first request (REQ-XE-113); an unfilled slot is `invalid_request`
  `plan_error` — the wire is never touched.
